threat_notes.note: Public surfaces: /ui/* (session-cookie auth), /api/* (API-key auth), MCP transport (API-key auth), IMAP inbox (allowlist + resolver). Everything else is internal.
Compromise of one tenant's API key surfaces that tenant's templates + renders only. Cross-tenant reach requires either an admin session or a vulnerability in the tenant-scope audit.
PDF / DOCX artifacts in MinIO/S3 (bucket-scoped IAM). Postgres holds hashes + metadata + audit rows. Session secret + webhook signing secret injected via env; never on disk.
TLS terminated at proxy. HSTS + Secure cookies signal HTTPS-only downstream. Webhooks HMAC-signed with per-tenant secret.

EU AI Act categorises healthcare eligibility decisions as high-risk and requires the exact reproducibility guarantees Verdikt provides mechanically. Building audit-defensible in 2026 is ahead of the regulatory curve.
